text: Fire water shall be provided for the design flow and pressure of DP-EPCE-0006 (the LDO tank, being the largest single hazard, plus a hose stream allowance, at 110 m head) with the storage of DP-EPCE-0007 (2 x 100 % tanks, 2 hours); the fire water is fresh water filled from the SWRO permeate (DEC-EPCE-0018); the fire pumps are one electric and one diesel pump each of 100 % (NFPA 20, DEC-EPCE-0014), the diesel pump shall start automatically on the low pressure of the ring main and the electric pump shall be supplied from the essential section; the fire water main shall be a buried looped ring main sectionalised so that no single break cuts the supply to more than one fire area.
